stringThrough has no length cap: it returns mu_i + 1 positions for any mu_i >= 0. T12 must bound the mu_i a reader can type. Also: minusculeMatrices returns null above the cap (default CAPS.repOrbit 2000, so E7 nodes 3 to 5 and E8 nodes 1 to 7 give null) and builds non-minuscule nodes such as D4 node 2. Matrix keys are spKey(row, column), with row = image and column = source. RelationCheck.i and .j are positions, so use toLabels for the q key (ef:1,2). The result type is NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof minusculeMatrices>>.
